messages:
marco: Heads up — quickstart README curl + Python snippets disagree with current SDK. Ran through onboarding and hit runtime error.

marco: Python snippet shows `client.embeddings.create(...)` and single `input` string. Current SDK uses `client.create_embeddings(model=..., inputs=[...])`.

rachel: Also the curl quickstart uses `input` instead of `inputs` and the JS snippet expects `response.data[0].vector` — which is wrong now (it's `embedding`).

marco: Error trace:
```
AttributeError: 'RedwoodClient' object has no attribute 'embeddings'
```

sam: We renamed method last sprint but promised doc compatibility shims. Looks like we never added the fallback for `embeddings.create` on the client.

sam: Plan: add a tiny shim that logs DeprecationWarning and delegates to create_embeddings; update README + add migration note. I'll open PR.

rachel: Can we also add a docs-smoke CI job that extracts codeblocks and runs them against sandbox creds? Would catch this earlier.

docs-ci-bot: Suggested job: `docs-smoke` — runs python & node snippets in ephemeral env, fails on non-zero exit. Created tracking issue #987.

marco: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sample-app/pull/512 — updates snippets, adds migration note, and docs-smoke job. PTAL @sam

sam: Leaving review comments. Agree on shim + tests. Merge once CI green. :shipit:
